parse_result_file: parse a FAISS benchmark result file and extract index key, results array, parameter keys, and statistics
collect_results_for: collect and aggregate benchmark results for a specified database and log file prefix from the logs directory
extract_pareto_optimal: extract Pareto-optimal points from benchmark results by filtering for best performance at each accuracy level
plot_subset: plot a subset of benchmark methods showing recall vs QPS tradeoffs with configurable report labels
plot_tradeoffs: plot recall vs QPS tradeoff curves for FAISS index methods filtered by code size range and recall rank
